mapper.select: SELECT run_id, fence, until_second, until_nano FROM public.agent_runtime_conversation_task_roots WHERE AND task_id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT task_id, revision, schema_id, snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_conversation_tasks WHERE AND status IN ('OPEN', 'WAITING_USER') AND (#{query} = '' OR strpos(lower(title || ' ' || summary), lower(#{query})) > 0) ORDER BY updated_second DESC, updated_nano DESC, task_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_conversation_tasks (tenant_id, agent_id, end_user_id, task_id, revision, status, title, summary, schema_id, snapshot, updated_second, updated_nano) VALUES (#{owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value}, #{agentId.value}, #{owner.requireUser.value}, #{task.taskId}, #{task.revision}, #{task.status}, #{task.title}, #{task.summary}, #{payload.schemaId}, #{payload.canonicalJson}, #{task.updatedAt.epochSecond}, #{task.updatedAt.nano}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, task_id) DO UPDATE SET revision = EXCLUDED.revision, status = EXCLUDED.status, title = EXCLUDED.title, summary = EXCLUDED.summary, schema_id = EXCLUDED.schema_id, snapshot = EXCLUDED.snapshot, updated_second = EXCLUDED.updated_second, updated_nano = EXCLUDED.updated_nano

INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_conversation_task_operations (tenant_id, agent_id, end_user_id, target_kind, target_id, task_id, session_id, event_id, expected_revision, selected) VALUES (#{owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value}, #{agentId.value}, #{owner.requireUser.value}, #{owner.target.kind}, #{owner.target.id}, #{taskId}, #{owner.sessionRef.sessionId}, #{eventId}, #{expectedRevision}, #{selected})

INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_conversation_task_bindings (tenant_id, agent_id, end_user_id, target_kind, target_id, session_id, task_id) VALUES (#{owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value}, #{agentId.value}, #{owner.requireUser.value}, #{owner.target.kind}, #{owner.target.id}, #{owner.sessionRef.sessionId}, #{taskId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, target_kind, target_id, session_id, agent_id) DO UPDATE SET task_id = EXCLUDED.task_id WHERE agent_runtime_conversation_task_bindings.end_user_id = EXCLUDED.end_user_id
